notes.title: Update 2.75
notes.content:
One-Armed Bandit: a new mechanic has been added — the One-Armed Bandit, designed to help players in the early stages of the game. This engaging mini-game allows players to replenish their balance and earn bonuses.

New Items: 26 unique items have been introduced, representing letters from A to Z. These items can be used for collecting or trading.

Autoplay Overhaul: the autoplay mechanic has been revamped. It is now available only after reaching level 10 prestige. The system is now more stable and flexible, improving the overall game dynamics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489755/b8643d0d337cc5dd18f09b9839bbb2802d6efe4a.png[/img]

notes.title: Economy in Action!
notes.content:
📦 Item Economy – every item now has its own drop rate. Collect rare items and build your unique collection!
🔄 Trading and Collecting – rare items can be traded with other players.
🎵 Improved Sound Effects – refined some sounds for a better experience.
🛠 Fixes and Enhancements – minor bug fixes and overall game stability improvements.
Stay tuned for more exciting mechanics in future updates!
